//: homepage -- the PRODUCTION artifact, built with `./build_it_please.sh --profile homepage`.
This file replaced the `--homepage` flag, ten `if $homepage` branches in build_it_please.sh, an
`inHomepage` boolean on every part, and a per-flavour list of files to delete again at the end
of the build (arc 5). What production contains is now readable in three lines.
The parts are listed EXPLICITLY rather than as an exclusion, because this is a shipped artifact:
its contents should be visible in one place, and a part added to the partition tomorrow should
NOT silently join production. Today that list is the product plus the in-world inspectors --
meta-tools has always been in a production build, and a `lean` profile (arc 5 phase 2) is what
Everything else about this tree FOLLOWS from these three facts, with nothing to maintain:
no harness part      -> no js/tests link, BUILDFLAG_LOAD_TESTS false, the tests-repo build
gates skipped, and the dead `if Automator?` branches stripped
index.html only      -> no SWCanvas boot bundle and no font-assets/ (~90 MB not deployed)
form precompiled     -> the pre-compile driver harvests the image from a compile-at-boot boot,
then it is minified in place; the world starts from that image and
loads the class sources afterwards, in the background
the absent parts      -> their assets and vendor payloads are simply never written (so no
fizzytiles 3D payload, no FileSaver/JSZip, no harness pointer icons)
